credits.title: Av. Mahsun Karaca: Ben Sana İnanıyorum
credits.overview: Eager to land prestigious clients, Mahsun, an ambitious lawyer puts up an online ad, only to end up saddled with a ruthless crime boss confined to house arrest. Dragged headfirst into dangerous underworld chaos, he must scramble to rid himself of his unwanted client before his career and life completely unravel.

credits.title: İllegal Hayatlar: Meclis
credits.overview: The political party, which Mahsun, Şahin and Mehmet established as a front to secretly gamble, accidentally entered the parliament. As a result, the trio find themselves in a brand new world full of opportunities. The story, which starts with illegal casino management, is moved to the parliament.

credits.title: Illegal Lives
credits.overview: Mahsun constantly has to cope with police raids since he runs an illegal casino. Because he wants to continue to run this casino, Mahsun decides to establish a fake political party as a disguise. credits.title: Enes Batur: Gerçek Kahraman
credits.overview: In the first film, Enes Batur was shy and unable to relate to those around him, showing the audience how his life changed through his social media posts. In this sequel, he becomes a part of "Justice Warriors" and embarks upon an adventure which will eventually make him a superhero.
